title: Multiomics Integration and Machine Learning Reveal Colony Stimulating Factor 3 Receptor as a Key Gene and Therapeutic Target in Crohn's Disease.
summary: Machine-learning feature selection across Crohn’s disease datasets converged on CSF3R, and Mendelian-randomization analysis supported a disease association. The result is reported in Mediators of Inflammation. Affiliation was not available in checked primary metadata; no organization is assigned. The study does not establish generalization beyond its reported setting or prospective real-world benefit. Affiliation was not stated in the reviewed material.
